financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Full tuition fees for a one-year master's at a UK university

stipend.notes: Monthly living allowance for accommodation and living costs; rate differs inside and outside London and is reviewed each year. Amount not published on the pages checked.

additional_benefits: Economy return airfare to the UK
TB test (up to GBP 75, where required)

application_fee.notes: Chevening charges no application fee. UK universities may charge their own course application fees.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: An undergraduate degree that gives entry to a UK master's; completed at least two years before the application deadline
eligibility_criteria.work_experience_years: 2 (at least 2,800 hours, gained after the undergraduate degree)

required_documents.name: Applications to three eligible UK master's courses
required_documents.detail: At least one unconditional offer needed by 8 Jul 2027, 17:00 UK time

required_documents.name: Undergraduate degree certificate
required_documents.detail: Can be missing at application but needed by the interview

preparation_alerts: Apply to three UK courses early; an unconditional offer is needed by 8 Jul 2027
Work experience must total at least 2,800 hours after your first degree
You must return to your home country for at least two years after the award

verification_status.verification_notes: Official pages confirm Nigeria is eligible, the 2027-2028 round is closed, closing time 11:00 UTC in October 2026, and the offer deadline of 8 Jul 2027. The exact opening (4 Aug 2026) and closing (6 Oct 2026) days come from secondary sources; the official timeline page only says 'August' and 'October'. Stipend amounts are not published on the pages checked. Only documents named on the pages checked are listed; the full document list (essays, references, etc.) was not confirmed and needs a human check.
